scope: Targeted source audit and fixed-reference diagnostics for independent mouse early-meiotic profiles; not a systematic review or a new trained reference.
source_selection: Candidates found from primary GEO records and original-paper data availability; explicit Leptotene separate from Zygotene preferred. Mixed LZ is a comparator, never a pure leptotene substitute. Green GSE112393 and Ernst E-MTAB-6946 are not independent of earlier reference/diagnostics.
filters: Require explicit mouse, source cell type, RNA-seq strategy, age/preparation and source file/sample identity before fitting.
Keep preleptotene distinct from leptotene and LZ; mutant zygotene-like is not WT zygotene.
Verify integer count semantics and gene identifiers, and record all exclusions; do not select profiles by fit quality.
Record synchronization and purification as confounders; no in-vivo pure-cell fraction truth or animal-level p-values inferred.
Keep original three references, full-universe five-fold seed and inverse-square-root centroid-4 weights fixed; no markers retuned.
New source must be held out from reference construction if used as validation. This turn only diagnoses fixed references, without training.
prior_work: Preserve all six older snapshots and their bound source/specification files. Store separately under results/leptotene_followup and leptotene_snapshot.
discovery_limitation: Scite plugin returned a transport error; official GEO and primary-paper records used as fallback. Discovery is targeted and not comprehensive.
